decisions.reason: As a prominently presented multi-item line that fits the firm's core natural facial-care offer and remained on its own page in 2023 and 2024, it is likely to stay in the range.

The hyaluronic acid serum is close to the firm's established skincare business and was still mentioned in 2024, so it likely has enough demand to remain despite being less prominently featured than A.

The cleansing oil is a very recent launch and somewhat less proven, but it fits the firm's portfolio and the growing skincare market, so management would more likely continue testing and supporting it than withdraw it immediately.
